notes: The Redevelopment Agency's Western Addition comparable-sales volumes, SFH371-5030 to 5038 (1,072 PDF pages, sales recorded 1965-1970). Each typed sheet gives block and lot, address, lot size, a description of the improvements with an approximate year built, income, taxes, grantor, grantee, recording date and price, with a photograph. Sheets were parsed from the OCR, resolved by block and lot, and every sheet that reached a page or a held parcel was read against its page image (the OCR misreads prices: $20,000 as 320,000). Private grantors and grantees, incomes and occupancy are not transcribed.

coverage.remaining: About 130 sheets on parcels with no page were parsed from the OCR but not read against their images (list in /mnt/project-files/sfra-comparable-sales/nopage.txt); read them when a parcel gets a page. About 65 sheets did not reach a parcel from the OCR address, and the land-sale sheets of 5036 and 5037 mostly lack a street number. The acquisition appraisals, SFH371-5001 to 5029, are unread.
coverage.note: Sheets on an existing page whose sale details are hidden under the pasted photograph (945-47 Oak, 2712 California, 726 Fillmore, 380 Page, 541-43 Oak, 505 Divisadero) and one too faint to read (537-39 Gough) are left out. Repeat sheets of the same sale (5038 pp. 29 and 31) are counted once.
